title: How to Know If Your Business Is Actually Ready for an AI Agent
description:
The reason AI agents fail almost never has anything to do with the model, the tools, or the price. It has to do with what was missing before anyone opened a single platform.

The business was not ready, and nobody checked.
Three questions determine readiness before a build starts.
Does a working process already exist, just running slowly. An agent speeds up and scales something that already produces a consistent outcome. It cannot invent a good process from scratch. If three people on the same team handle the same request three different ways, that is chaos, not a process, and no agent fixes chaos.

Does the task happen often enough to matter. Something that comes up twice a month barely moves the needle when automated. Something that happens daily pays for the build fast even with rough early performance.

Can someone on the team clearly explain how they do it and why. If the person doing the job cannot articulate their own judgment, the agent has nothing to replicate.

All three confirmed and you are in the ten percent that works. Miss one and you are funding the other ninety.
